title: The Alchemical Transmutation Run Length
statement:
You are given a string S consisting of uppercase English letters and an integer K.
You can choose any character of the string and change it to any other uppercase English character. You can perform this operation at most K times.

Return the length of the longest substring containing the same letter you can get after performing the above operations.
inputFormat:
First line: String S.
Second line: Integer K.

sampleCases.explanation: Replace two 'A's with 'B's or vice versa to get "BBBB" or "AAAA" of length 4.
Replace the middle 'A' with 'B' to get "AABBBBA" containing "BBBB" of length 4.
